messages:
Ellen: quick follow-up from today's all-hands 16: can we get a bite-sized decision guide for the GTM and docs teams on when to recommend Hosted / Dedicated / Private?
Ravi: absolutely, folks keep asking for a one-pager. high-level: Hosted = try-first, low friction; Dedicated = committed capacity & predictable perf; Private = compliance/air-gapped.
Priya: can we make that into a 3-line checklist each? the sales playbook wants signals not long text.
Aisha: proposed checklists below, feel free to copy: 
```
Hosted:
- Use when customer prioritizes fast PI and low setup cost
- Good for PLG trial, variable QPS, no strict residency/KMS needs
- Recommend if buyer asks for "just try" or pay-as-you-go

Dedicated:
- Use when steady high QPS or contractual latency SLAs required
- Customer willing to commit spend for predictability
- Escalate if multi-tenant noise causes tail latency spikes

Private:
- Use when legal/regulatory or procurement requires private network or KMS control
- For air-gapped/on-prem or strict audit requirements
- Useful when compliance blocks hosted endpoints
```
Ravi: thanks. also include a short note for engineers: priority of infra work is 1) keep Hosted robust and cost-competitive (impacts PLG funnel), 2) Dedicated perf and packing, 3) Private packaging & compliance automation.
Ellen: perfect. can we add example customer cues for handoffs to Sales Ops? (e.g., "billing ready to commit", "security questionnaire requests KMS")
Aisha: examples: committed budget, procurement SLAs, SOC2+ requests for data residency, legal disallowing cross-tenant data. add that to playbook.
Priya: I'll slot this into the one-pager and make a slide for the GTM deck. any leadership quote we can use on the slide about Redwood's positioning vs model marketplaces or infra vendors?
Aisha: draft blurb: "Redwood focuses on serving: predictable latency, clear unit economics, and flexible deployment pathways so engineers can ship features without spending months on inference ops."
Ellen: nice and short. ops-bot: recording + deck link?
ops-bot: all-hands recording + assets: https://redwood.slack/all-hands/2161114327 (auto-post)
Ravi: last ask from eng: can SRE get a short checklist for Dedicated readiness (metrics to monitor + fallback policies)? I'll coordinate a doc with platform.
Aisha: yes 10: include p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, cost/1M tokens, and an automatic fallback to a compatible model variant in a secondary region.
Priya: thanks team, will publish the playbook update before EOD Monday. :thumbsup:
Ellen: thanks everyone, closing the loop.
